tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find reviewed products by buying guide, type, price, installation, width or room size. Each result has its dated US price, main trade-off, who it isn’t for, and a store link with its disclosure.

tools.name: recommend_products
tools.description: The buying guides’ picks (the editor’s choice for each use in a guide) that fit the constraints, with dated US prices and store links.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product’s full review data: specifications, warranty, returns, consumables, three-year cost, limitations, unknowns and cited sources.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Two to four products of the same type side by side: prices, specifications, warranty, returns, three-year cost, limitations and sources.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: One product’s evidence entries, cited sources with check dates, unknowns and limitations, and the guide’s evidence review.

tools.name: running_cost
tools.description: What a product costs to own over 1 to 10 years: purchase, installation, consumables and electricity. A cost the review doesn’t know is named, never counted as zero.
